svg.title: How a lock file of pip-compile fixes itself
svg.desc: A pull request changes a source, such as requirements-dev.in. The step Lock files match their sources has uv compile each lock file again, on a copy, for the Python of its header and on the versions that it pins, and compares the pins. Without a difference, the file stays as it is, also after a new release upstream. With one, the check fails, and the autofix keeps the result below the header of the file; the fix bot commits it, and the checks run again. When uv finds no solution, nothing changes, and the log says why.
